period_note: Recovered via a Wayback Machine capture of DSE's OWN company page (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=PUBALIBANK), NOT the bank's site. This vintage of the table (titled 'Interim Financial Performance: <year>', 2016 onward) gives Turnover/Revenue, Profit for the period, Basic EPS and period-end market price, with Q2/Q3 given BOTH as a discrete quarter figure AND a separate cumulative (Half Yearly / 9 Months) figure side by side -- identical table structure to the one already documented for RUPALIBANK. Sourced from DSE's (dsebd.org) own company-page interim table, NOT the bank's own site (pubalibangla.com, Cloudflare-blocked). Solo/Standalone basis presumed, consistent with this bank's established series basis, but not explicitly labeled solo vs consolidated on the DSE page itself -- flagged as an assumption, not a confirmed fact (same caveat documented for RUPALIBANK's use of this identical source type). TURNOVER/REVENUE DELIBERATELY OMITTED FOR THIS QUARTER (AND FOR Q2/Q3 OF THE SAME YEAR): an earlier Wayback capture of this same URL (2021-06-09, closer to Q1's original filing) shows a materially different Turnover/Revenue figure (785.41 BDT mn) for this identical nominal period (202103) than this source's later capture (5623.83) -- Profit for the period was IDENTICAL (1011.56) across both captures, so the instability is confined to the already-ambiguous Turnover/Revenue field (this dataset's RUPALIBANK sourcing notes already flag this DSE generic-template row as having an unclear definition for banks). Given this directly-observed instability for this specific bank/year, Turnover/Revenue is excluded from all of FY2021's quarter files rather than picking one of two conflicting reported values.
